swap_risks: CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 10 µF, p.3), whereas AMS1117-3.3 is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: See datasheet ESR curve). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on AMS1117-3.3 can trigger control-loop oscillation.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 2.2x (AMS1117-3.3: 22 µF p.4 vs AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: 10 µF p.3); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 supplies up to 800 mA (p.7) compared to AMS1117-3.3 at 1000 mA (p.1); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AMS1117-3.3 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (15 V, p.2) than AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (18 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 15 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 39% higher on AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (AMS1117-3.3: 90 °C/W p.2 vs AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: 125 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AMS1117-3.3: -40..125 °C Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ) vs AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: -20..125 °C Extended Commercial (-20°C to +125°C TJ — NOT -40°C Industrial)); AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 cold limit only -20 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AMS1117-3.3 (Advanced Monolithic Systems, SOT-223-3) and AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-223-3) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because ceramic output capacitor ESR stability difference; minimum output capacitance requirement differs 2.2x; Iout,max rating drops >=20%. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 22.9 °C on AMS1117-3.3 (θJA 90 °C/W) vs 31.9 °C on AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (θJA 125 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1.3x ratio (5000 µA (p.3) vs 4000 µA (p.7)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AMS1117-3.3 "NOT Ceramic-Cap Stable — Requires 22 uF Solid Tantalum (No Numeric ESR Window Published)" (p.4) and AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 "Operating Temperature Stops at -20°C — NOT Rated for -40°C Industrial Grade" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose AMS1117-3.3 when load current exceeds 800 mA (up to 1000 mA) or lower package θJA (90 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin; choose AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 when your BOM standardizes on low-ESR MLCC ceramic output capacitors. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.2) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
